definitions.explanation: the amount of money paid or required in exchange for goods or services
the negative consequences or sacrifices incurred as a result of an action or choice

examples.japanese: ⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{代価|だいか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支払|しはら}う→支払う：02116_shiharau⟧。
examples.english: To pay the price for the goods.

examples.japanese: {代価|だいか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{請求|せいきゅう}→請求：03374_seikyuu⟧⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧。
examples.english: The payment will be billed later.

examples.japanese: ⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{代価|だいか}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{月額|げつがく}→月額：09739_getsugaku⟧⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}します→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧。
examples.english: A monthly fee is charged as the price for the service.

examples.japanese: ⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{代価|だいか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きかった→大きい：00335_ookii⟧。
examples.english: The price of success was great.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}る→得る：02014_eru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{払|はら}った→払う：00535_harau⟧{代価|だいか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{計|はか}り{知|し}れない。
examples.english: The price paid to gain freedom is immeasurable.

examples.japanese: ⟦{無理|むり}→無理：01558_muri⟧な⟦{労働|ろうどう}→労働：03785_roudou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{代価|だいか}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}った→失う：01887_ushinau⟧。
examples.english: He lost his health as the cost of overwork.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{代|だい}→〜代：28331_dai⟧ (substitute, price) and {価|か} (value). Used both for literal monetary payment and figuratively for the cost or sacrifice associated with achieving something.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {代価|だいか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧: to pay the price
- {代価|だいか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支払|しはら}う→支払う：02116_shiharau⟧: to pay the cost (formal)
- {代価|だいか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧: to demand payment
- ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{代価|だいか}: a great price/cost

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{対価|たいか}→対価：12434_taika⟧: compensation, consideration — specifically the value given in return for something; more common in contracts and legal language
- ⟦{代金|だいきん}→代金：03416_daikin⟧: payment, price — more concrete, refers to the actual money exchanged
- ⟦{犠牲|ぎせい}→犠牲：14743_gisei⟧: sacrifice — emphasizes loss rather than exchange
- ⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧: price — the everyday word for the price of goods
